---
title: "Simulation visualization"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggh4x)
library(RColorBrewer)
theme_set(theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "black"),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(1, "line"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "gray", fill = NA),
    axis.line.y = element_line(size = 0.5, linetype = "solid", colour = "black"),
    axis.line.x = element_line(size = 0.5, linetype = "solid", colour = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown(),
    strip.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    strip.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12)
  )
)

```

# Linear model visualization

## Linear regression

```{r, fig.width=10}
# Load the CSV file
sim_result <- read.csv('../linear_result/linear_regression_20072024.csv')

# Print unique values
print(unique(sim_result$data_kwargs))
print(unique(sim_result$model_kwargs_l))

# Select specific columns
sim_result <- sim_result %>%
  select(L, N, p, method, Lower_bound, contain, Upper_bound, points_in_e1, inner_points_num, outer_points_num)

# Optionally filter the data
sim_result_sub <- sim_result # %>% filter(p == 6) # %>% filter(N != 800) # %>% filter(method == 'CS_on_mean')

# Drop 'Lower_bound' column and rename others
t <- sim_result_sub %>%
  select(-Lower_bound) %>%
  rename(TLB = L,
         Coverage = contain,
         EUB = Upper_bound,
         `Points in IB` = points_in_e1,
         `Inner Set` = inner_points_num,
         `Outer set` = outer_points_num) %>%
  mutate(Coverage = ifelse(Coverage=="True",1,0)) %>% 
  group_by(p, TLB, N, method) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), mean, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), round, 2)) %>% 
  mutate(`Outcome Type` = ifelse(grepl("mean", method), "Mean", "Observed Y"),
         Method = ifelse(grepl("CS", method), "CS", "Naive")
         )


ggplot(t, aes(x = factor(N), y = Coverage, fill = Method)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color="black", position = position_dodge(), width = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = TLB), data = t,  linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Coverage, ymax = EUB), position = position_dodge(0.7), width = 0.25) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  facet_nested(p ~ TLB+`Outcome Type`, labeller = labeller(p = label_both, TLB = label_both)) +
  labs(x = "Sample Size (N)", y = "Coverage Rate", fill = "Method") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1))
```
